tools.name: Ollama
tools.description: Local models, OpenAI-compatible at /v1. The assistant dock talks to it.
tools.notes: Install from ollama.com. This start command is the default install location.

tools.name: LM Studio server
tools.description: LM Studio's local server, OpenAI-compatible at /v1. Start it from LM Studio's Developer tab.
tools.notes: Optional. Remove this entry if you don't use LM Studio.

tools.name: Hangar speech-to-text
tools.description: faster-whisper on the CPU for the assistant's mic. Never uses the GPU.
tools.notes: Needs: pip install faster-whisper fastapi uvicorn python-multipart. Started by the assistant on first mic use; the first transcription loads the model.

tools.name: Kokoro voice
tools.description: Read-aloud voices on the CPU (Kokoro-FastAPI, OpenAI speech API).
tools.notes: Optional. Run Kokoro-FastAPI on port 8880 (its default), or set HANGAR_TTS_URL to another Kokoro-compatible server.

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.notes: Example. Point cwd and folder at your ComfyUI folder, and the first cmd entry at its Python.
